verdict.probe_answer: The memo correctly recommends the tri-state design: split Hidden/Unknown/multi, continue only when all bindings are provably Hidden, poison on Unknown (undecidable pub(in)), and explicitly frames the 14,663 count as target population not guaranteed recall — matching the vindicated design-of-record exactly. It also correctly recommends the hybrid architecture (policy hook + richer rib probe return type) rather than picking a single naive option, keeps the engine language-neutral by not calling vis_reaches directly, and proposes telemetry bucket splits (member_multi/member_hidden_continued/member_undecidable) mirroring what shipped. Minor gaps: it doesn't explicitly restate the cardinal invariant phrase ('may miss an edge but never mint a wrong singleton') verbatim, though the substance (sibling-glob wrong-singleton risk analysis) is present and correct.
verdict.rationale: All four grading dimensions are satisfied: the recommendation shape matches (tri-state, continue-only-on-all-Hidden, poison-on-Unknown), the load-bearing caveat (buy is the small reached-subset, not raw 14,663) is explicitly called out, scope is calibrated (light-medium effort, phased telemetry-before-recall-claims), and following this memo would have avoided both failure modes (naive full-recall over-claim and unsound continue-on-Unknown).
